summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a 6-K reporting that shareholders at an Extraordinary General Meeting approved the acquisition of Royal Uranium Inc. via a Share Exchange Agreement dated February 18, 2026. The resolution passed with 816,174 votes for, 831 against, and 3,116 abstentions. The number of shares to be issued or consideration was not stated. The board recommended the deal; no advisors named. The acquisition requires completion of the share exchange agreement; regulatory clock unspecified. Watch for closing conditions or material changes from the agreement.
